summary: Master ESG Due Diligence in M&A, procurement, and investment with SASB, TCFD, and ILPA frameworks. 5-day intermediate course for Investment Managers and M&A spe
lede: ESG Due Diligence in Mergers, Procurement and Investment helps professionals identify, assess, and quantify material environmental, social, and governance risks and opportunities. The course applies SASB Standards, TCFD Recommendations, and ILPA Due Diligence Questionnaires to support structured assessments across transactions and supply chains. Build practical skills through data room checklists, climate risk exposure calculations, ESG-adjusted valuation models, and 100-Day Integration Plans. You will also explore governance reviews, mock Investment Committee presentations, AI-powered screening tools, and digital dashboards while balancing thoroughness, efficiency, budget constraints, and data collection challenges.
